svg.title: Contribution Graph → Invaders — Daniel Rabottini
svg.desc: Actual GitHub contribution calendar, 2025-10-19 to 2026-10-24. Original 12-pixel squares on a 16-pixel grid. 45 active days reveal eyes and edge notches in a single left-to-right geometric transformation from 2.5538 to 6.6769 seconds, at twice its original speed. Contribution colors stay unchanged. Positions are preserved through the morph. Empty days fade away; they never become invaders. Stars appear after 3.4769 seconds and move slowly right to left at two depths. After the original morph, each invader deploys along its own path into a density-preserving organic arrangement on the right. Generation-time random offsets retain original clusters and negative space. From 10.5069 seconds, individual lateral advances, descents and upward recoveries use distinct deterministic phases, paths and periods. No moving parent carries the horde. The left 15 percent remains reserved after deployment. Mobile preserves the same calendar geometry. Reduced motion and the static fallback show the complete initial graph without stars. A pixel spacecraft enters from the upper left at one quarter of the scene height during deployment, from 7.6819 to 10.3069 seconds. It dives gently along a curved path, progressively levelling from 26 degrees nose-down to horizontal at the centre of the reserved left area. After entry, it moves vertically toward the available invader with the smallest current x, breaking exact ties by date. It fires a constant-speed horizontal projectile at a predicted intercept, locks that target and immediately moves toward the next one while earlier shots continue independently. At impact each invader freezes in place, blends into a short white and aqua arcade burst, then disappears; after all targets have been fired upon the ship holds its last position. Three faint, curved vector trails attach to its engine outlets; the central trail is longer and wider. Reduced motion keeps the spacecraft hidden and replaces each hit with a brief static burst at its original calendar position, followed by disappearance. After every invader and its explosion have disappeared, large pixel-art lettering reading GITHUB SAVED! fades in at the centre of the starfield. After one second fully visible, the entire scene fades out together, resets while completely hidden against the existing theme background, and fades in the exact initial contribution graph. The approved timeline then restarts. Reduced motion uses the same simple opacity transition.
